ground.method: 2m cell 28th percentile of nearly horizontal low mesh; inverse-distance fill then 1.3-cell Gaussian smoothing, independent of equipment geometry
ground.limitations: Ground interpolated through missing building/roof areas; no excavation or survey accuracy claim.

north_wall.evidence: Two visible north return corners; long connecting north wall missing in reconstruction, inferred closure.

road.method: Regularized curves from the visible smooth road and curb bands in B34_low_site_plan plus DJI0001/0002/0005/0027/0059. Road construction widths not independently surveyed.

remaining: Small fenced auxiliary device and ground hatches
